title: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
description: The seven claimants, who include Sir Elton John and Liz Hurley, have to pay the Daily Mail publisher an initial £9.54m in the next seven days after losing a privacy case.

title: Meghan in talks for role in Netflix series The Gentlemen, BBC understands
description: This would be Meghan's first significant acting role since her marriage to Prince Harry.

title: Watch: How 'strongest' El Niño could affect weather around the world
description: The powerful natural climate phenomenon, that is developing over the Pacific Ocean, is likely to be the strongest in living memory, the Met Office has warned.
